title: Elementary etale spreading of a geometrically irreducible smooth-fibre open
statement: Let $h:Y\to S$ be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] of finite presentation (locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated) [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $s\in S$ and let $T\subseteq Y_s=Y\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ be an open subscheme [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-open-immersion] geometrically irreducible over $\kappa(s)$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There exist an affine scheme $S_1$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], an etale morphism $a:S_1\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a point $s_1\in S_1$ with $a(s_1)=s$ inducing an isomorphism $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(s_1)$, and a quasi-compact open subscheme $V\subseteq Y\times_S S_1$, such that every fibre of $V\to S_1$ is geometrically integral and $V_{s_1}=T\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)}\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s_1)$ as open subschemes of $(Y\times_S S_1)_{s_1}$. Geometrically integral has the meaning of [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible, def-pc-integral-scheme].

source.place: Tag 057J, lemma-normal-morphism-irreducible, specialized to a smooth morphism using Tag 056W, lemma-smooth-normal; exactly the application in Tag 057K.

proof.text: Fix any field extension $L/\kappa(s)$. By [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], $T_L$ is irreducible, hence nonempty by [def-weil-irreducible-components]. If $T_L=A\amalg B$ for two nonempty clopen subsets, then $A$ and $B$ are proper closed subsets covering $T_L$, contrary to irreducibility. Thus $T_L$ is nonempty and connected [def-weil-connected-scheme]. Since $L$ was arbitrary, $T$ is geometrically connected, including nonemptiness after every field extension.

source.place: Tag 057J, first proof sentence: geometric irreducibility supplies geometric connectedness for Tag 055W.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-smooth-connected-open-spreading] with the given $h:Y\to S$, point $s$ and embedded open $T\subseteq Y_s$. Smoothness and all three finite-presentation conditions are hypotheses of the item; step 1 supplies geometric connectedness. Choose its affine $S_1$, etale $a:S_1\to S$, point $s_1$ with $a(s_1)=s$ and residue-field isomorphism, and quasi-compact open $V\subseteq Y\times_S S_1$. Its composite $v:V\to S_1$ is smooth with geometrically connected nonempty fibres. The lemma gives $V_{s_1}=T\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)}\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s_1)$ as embedded open subschemes of the designated ambient fibre; retain precisely this $V$.

source.place: Tag 057J, first two proof sentences; smooth specialization of Tag 055W and smooth base change and restriction.

proof.text: In [lem-trf-smooth-connected-fibre-normal-integrality] take $B=S_1$ and the same $v:V\to S_1$. Step 2 supplies both hypotheses. For every $t\in S_1$ and every extension $K/\kappa(t)$ the lemma says that $V_t\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)}\operatorname{Spec}K$ is integral. By [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] this is exactly geometric integrality of $V_t$. The point $t$ was arbitrary, so every fibre is geometrically integral. This application changes no chosen object: affineness, etaleness, the point equation, residue-field isomorphism, quasi-compactness and equality of embedded open fibres are all those already obtained in step 2.

source.place: Tag 057J, final geometric-fibre argument; Varieties Tag 056T and Properties Tag 033M.
